n25ba4f3e18.headline: Russia Finally Opens Its Borders To Tajik Migrants, But Exorbitant Airfares Keeping Laborers Out
n25ba4f3e18.summary: Russia has reopened its borders to Tajik migrants after pandemic restrictions, but high plane ticket prices are limiting travel for many laborers.
n25ba4f3e18.why: Labor migration from Tajikistan to Russia is vital for remittances supporting Tajikistan's economy, so border reopening affects regional labor markets and economic flows.
